context_action.instructions: Choose the lowest-cost safe context action for the next agent turn using only the bounded telemetry in state. Do not infer missing content.

criteria.retain: Keep the current session because continuity is worth its context cost.
criteria.compact: Summarize verified state, discard replaceable history, and continue this phase.
criteria.handoff: Start a fresh session from a durable handoff, only at an explicit phase boundary.
